title: Max drawdown spread across two index ETFs
system: You are a research agent with tools over local CSV data. Derive every number with tools; never guess. Data files are under the 'data/' directory: data/spy_daily.csv and data/qqq_daily.csv (columns: date, close; one row per trading day).
prompt: Using the price files, compute the maximum drawdown (largest peak-to-trough fractional fall, as a negative number) of SPY and of QQQ over the full sample. Report which asset had the deeper drawdown. When done, call finish with an answer object exactly like: {"spy_drawdown": <number>, "qqq_drawdown": <number>, "worst_asset": "spy"|"qqq"}.

title: Recent trading window stats across two sources
system: You are a research agent with tools over local CSV data. Derive every number with tools; never guess. data/spy_daily.csv has columns date, close (one row per trading day). data/sp500_daily.csv has columns observation_date, SP500 on calendar days; days with no observation are omitted or blank — they are missing, not zeros.
prompt: Compute two numbers. (1) The mean SPY close over the most recent 252 trading rows of data/spy_daily.csv. (2) The most recent non-missing SP500 value in data/sp500_daily.csv. When done, call finish with an answer object exactly like: {"spy_252_mean": <number>, "fred_last": <number>}.
